sourceAdaptations: Full16 bodies; exact Japanese examples/readings/forms/path/type/tags/JLPT remain, no learner-facing English fallback.
復習 English revision contrast becomes Russian repeated study versus draft editing; homophone復讐 remains distinct.
教育 keeps sustained learning/training/upbringing rather than one fact, and employee/home contexts; no artificial learner/educator synonym rule.
School-stage terms describe enrollment, not exact age; university versus senior-high institutions/person suffix retained.
校長 remains gender-neutral in Japanese; remove dependency on English headmaster rather than invent a male restriction.
辞典/辞書 overlap;事典 same spoken reading but separate written encyclopedia, not alternate reading of辞典.
文法 and発音 keep spoken/written distinction, nouns/する/の patterns and pronunciation versus reading assignment.
説明 retains recipientに/contentを and explaining versus understanding/persuading; mnemonic not guarantee.
調べる retains native ichidan, information object/tool roles and lookup versus searching for a dictionary; no English look-up dependency.
Only unavailable optional wrappers removed; retain available source card links including any new-root providers. No optional comparison translated merely to force a provider.
unadoptedInferenceBoundaries: No transitive teaching/student, room/event, generic study, speech or verb clique.
Absent runtime探す and音 remain source-only comparisons, no negative declaration or English provider added.
No調べる–弾く music guard: actual complete1429060 has only examination/inquiry sense; shared調/しらべ is not evidence.
No automatic all-schoolchildren/young people, university/foreign-national, every-building/room, every-spoken-sound or everyclass-rank guard.
教育–習う teacher/learner roles and講義–クラス actual group/class label require exact assessment, not automatic category extension.
Historical学生/先生 and unrelatedホール entries retained separately; their captured presence does not merge senses or prove present-day frequency.
